title: A fresh sandbox per run
description: Run each agent run in its own new sandbox in your Modal, Daytona or E2B account. Your token is tested before it is kept, stored encrypted, and never shown again. Choose a connected platform under Runs go to.
sharedHint: Runs on the Heimdall shared worker.
needToken: Paste the token to test it.
needTokenAndEndpoint: Paste the token and the endpoint to test them.
confirmDisconnect: Disconnect {{platform}}? Its token is deleted; if it is the default, runs go back to the shared worker.
defaultNote: Some tasks cannot run in a cloud sandbox (for example tasks that start their own services). Those stay on the shared worker; the run page says why.
off: Worker platforms need the hosted server with a keystore master key.

registry.title: Image registry
registry.needed: Modal needs an image registry it can pull from. Add one on the Modal card.
registry.help: Heimdall pushes each image your runs use to this registry and Modal pulls it from there with the same login. Use a private registry you own and a token that can push and pull.
registry.token: Token with push and pull rights
registry.confirmRemove: Remove the image registry of {{platform}}? Runs cannot go to {{platform}} until you add one again.
registry.needAll: Fill in the registry path, the user name and the token.
registry.error: Could not save the image registry

capability.runs: Runs on Modal: repository tasks graded on the code change, with gateway faults.
capability.notRuns: Not on Modal: some tasks cannot run in a cloud sandbox (for example tasks that start their own services or need a GPU). Those stay on the shared worker; the run page says why.
